h:
我使用一个简单的 Comfyui 工作流程进行基本测试和图像生成。包含“RTX 视频超分辨率”升级节点，用于升级图像和视频。仅适用于 Nvidia RTX GPU。https://github.com/Comfy-Org/Nvidia_RTX_Nodes_ComfyUI.git

26年5月2日更新

还为非 nvidia 用户添加了种子 vr2 版本。质量大致相同，但我更喜欢 RTX 解决方案，因为它明显更快（几乎是即时的），而且我更喜欢稍微好一点的升级质量。

仍然可能更好地采用良好的锻造工作流程：p。

o.en:
A simple Comfyui Workflow I use for basic testing and image generation. Contains the "RTX Video Super Resolution" upscaling node to upscale images and videos. Only works on Nvidia RTX GPUs.https://github.com/Comfy-Org/Nvidia_RTX_Nodes_ComfyUI.git

05/2/26 update

Also added seed vr2 version for non nvidia users. The quality is about the same though I prefer RTX solution as it is notably faster (almost instant) and I prefer the upscalling quality slightly better.

Still probably better to go with a good forge workflow :p.
